mostWorthwhile.text: Supplying the deeper skin was most worthwhile: it showed how living cells in the outer layer get supplies even though that layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland into its named slot was straightforward but didn't add much explanation on its own.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from below.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the named slots made the fittings clear, though adding the nerve endings was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the skin chapter made a familiar body surface more interesting by connecting protection, sensation and sweat, though some fittings were predictable.
